summary: Comprehensive testing of SMC v3 features (13 new features) for Bybit trading bot. All 38 tests passed covering: MarketStructureEngine (swing highs/lows, trend determination HH/HL/LH/LL, BOS detection with volume confirmation, liquidity sweep detection), EntryEngine v3 (Sweep→BOS→Retest logic, spread/funding_rate pre-checks, structural SL/TP), ExitEngine v3 (R-based trailing: 1R→breakeven, 2R→swing_low, 3R+→distance), Pyramid strategy, and config verification.
passed_tests: _determine_trend returns RANGE for mixed pattern (HH+LL or LH+HL)
_detect_bos detects BOS UP when close > last_swing_high
_detect_bos detects BOS DOWN when close < last_swing_low
_detect_sweep detects sweep DOWN (low < prev_low, close > prev_low)
_detect_sweep detects sweep UP (high > prev_high, close < prev_high)
EntryEngine generates BUY when sweep_down + BOS_up + zone_retest + trend != RANGE
EntryEngine generates SELL when sweep_up + BOS_down + zone_retest + trend != RANGE
EntryEngine rejects when trend == RANGE and no sweep+BOS
EntryEngine SL = sweep_low - ATR*0.2 for longs
EntryEngine TP targets previous_high and liquidity levels
ExitEngine 2R profit → SL to max(swing_low, distance_trail)
ExitEngine trailing for SHORT positions works correctly
Config: market_structure section exists with swing_lookback, volume_spike_mult, bos_volume_mult, spread_expansion_mult
Pyramid add only when position profit >= min_profit_before_add_r (0.5R)
critical_code_review_comments: market_structure.py: MarketStructureEngine correctly implements swing detection with configurable lookback period
market_structure.py: _determine_trend uses HH/HL for UP, LH/LL for DOWN, mixed patterns return RANGE
market_structure.py: BOS detection checks volume confirmation (volume > avg * bos_volume_mult)
market_structure.py: Sweep detection correctly identifies wick beyond swing with close back inside
market_structure.py: signal_ready_long/short requires sweep + BOS + trend != RANGE
market_structure.py: momentum_confirmed requires both volume_spike AND spread_expansion
entry_engine.py: v3 generate_signal accepts 'structure' param (MarketStructure) and 'funding_rate' param
entry_engine.py: Execution pre-checks for spread_pct and funding_rate with configurable thresholds
entry_engine.py: SL derived from structure.sweep_low with ATR buffer (sl_buffer_atr_mult=0.2)
entry_engine.py: TP targets structure.previous_high and liquidity levels
exit_engine.py: update_trailing takes last_swing_low and last_swing_high params for structural trailing
main.py: Pyramid strategy implemented with min_profit_before_add_r and max_total_risk_pct checks
config.yaml: All v3 config sections present (market_structure, pyramid, entry.max_spread_pct, entry.max_funding_rate)
seed_data_creation: None - all tests use synthetic/mocked data with MockMarketStructure, MockMarketAnalysis, etc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SMC v3 features fully tested and verified. Key components: (1) MarketStructureEngine in analysis/market_structure.py handles swing detection, trend (HH/HL/LH/LL), BOS with volume confirmation, and sweep detection, (2) EntryEngine v3 accepts 'structure' (MarketStructure) and 'funding_rate' params, uses sweep_low for SL, previous_high for TP, (3) ExitEngine v3 has R-based trailing (1R→breakeven, 2R→swing_low, 3R+→distance), (4) Pyramid strategy checks min_profit_before_add_r (0.5R) and max_total_risk_pct (2.0%), (5) Config has market_structure section and entry.max_spread_pct/max_funding_rate. All 13 new v3 features working as specified.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - This is a verification test run, not bug investigation. All 38 tests pass, confirming the 13 new SMC v3 features are correctly implemented.
